questions.prompt_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {设} \lambda \text {服从参数为2的指数分布，}X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n} \text {是与} X \text {同分布且相互独立的随机变量序列，则当}n \rightarrow \infty, \\ Y_{n} = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^{n} X_{i}^{2} \text {依概率收敛于( ).} \end{array}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由题设可知}X_{i}\sim E(2),\ \text{因此} \\&\quad E(X_{i}^{2})=D(X_{i})+[E(X_{i})]^{2}=\frac{1}{\lambda^{2}}+\frac{1}{\lambda^{2}}=\frac{2}{\lambda^{2}}=\frac{1}{2}.\\&\text{根据切比雪夫大数定律的推广：若}X_{1},X_{2},\cdots \text{具有相同的数学期望}E(X_{i})=\mu,\ \text{则对于任意的正数}\varepsilon,\ \text{有} \\&\quad\lim_{i\rightarrow \infty}P\bigg(\left|\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}X_{i}-\mu\right|<\varepsilon\bigg)=1.\\&\text{因此，}\ \lim_{i\rightarrow \infty}P\bigg(\left|\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}X_{i}^{2}-\frac{1}{2}\right|<\varepsilon\bigg)=1.\ \text{即当}n\rightarrow \infty \text{时，}Y_{n}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}X_{i}^{2}\text{依概率收敛于}\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
